The following events took place in '''3954 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Kreia]] is stripped of her title of Darth Traya and connection to the Force by [[Darth Sion]] and [[Darth Nihilus]].
*The [[First Jedi Purge]] begins: under orders from Darth Sion, [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] emerge from [[Malachor V]] to wage a shadow war against the Jedi Order. They attempt to exterminate the few remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and they largely succeed in doing so.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*Much of what remains of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] is [[Sith Triumvirate|unified]] under the rule of Darth Sion and Darth Nihilus, with [[Malachor V]] as its capital. However, the [[Sith Civil War]] does not die out completely; some Sith warlords continue to battle over the territorial scraps of the empire.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] joined the [[Nathema conspiracy]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
